task: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First of all, unlock the door within the bedroom. And then, make sure that the door within the bedroom is wide open. After that, attempt to move east. With that accomplished, make an attempt to go to the north. And then, make an effort to venture north. Next, move west. With that done, go to the north. Then, attempt to go to the east. Then, venture east. That done, attempt to take a trip south. After that, ensure that the maple passageway inside the scullery is open. And then, make an attempt to move east. Okay, and then, travel east. Then, travel north. After that, make sure that the case within the kitchen is wide open. And then, retrieve the cookie from the case. And once you've done that, you win!
